in_sanskrit.name: Imdadul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Benefactor of the faithful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Imdadul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Islam, Imdadul refers to a benefactor or supporter of the faithful. In Hindu mythology, the name Imdadul may be derived from the Sanskrit words 'im' (in, towards) and 'dad' (to give), indicating one who gives towards or is dedicated to a cause.

in_hindi.name: ईमददूल
in_hindi.meaning: ईमदा (Imdad) - विभाग्य, समर्थन (Vibhagya, Samarthan) - उल (ul) - वह वह जीवनदेव (vah vah jivanadev) - वह वह दिव्य जीवनप्रद (vah vah divya jivanaprad)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the embodiment of generosity and kindness, the one who provides help and support, the one who is the giver of divine life
